title: How we load tested Depot Metal before scaling up
summary: We built a production-shaped load test to find control-plane limits before moving more GitHub Actions traffic to Depot Metal. Each run made our scaling changes measurable.
body_markdown: The test does not need to reproduce production perfectly. It needs to exercise the behavior you want to measure, produce consistent results across repeated runs, and show a meaningful before-and-after difference when the system changes. If a harness change alters the workload, establish a new baseline before comparing results.
